biography.plain_text: Jon Aage Sørensen is a Norwegian engineer and founder of Jotne Group. After a decade at Kværner, he started an engineering consultancy in 1982 and expanded it into a family-owned group spanning industrial fabrication, information technology, transport engineering and property. He retained group oversight as chair of Jotne Holding and Jotne Eiendom.

long_biography.plain_text:
Jotne's acquisition of much of the former Fredrikstad Mekaniske Verksted site in 1998 opened a second chapter for Sørensen's company. Land once tied to workshops became the base for Jotne Eiendom, which has pursued housing, commercial property and urban development while retaining elements of the industrial setting.

The move built on an engineering career. Sørensen spent ten years at Kværner before establishing Jotne as a consultancy and project-management business. It subsequently expanded into metal fabrication, industrial services, engineering software and transport consultancy. His later career centred on board leadership across the holding, industrial, technology and property companies after daily management passed to other executives. The sequence from salaried civil engineer to founder and long-serving chairman defines his role in the group, while its spread into distinct businesses explains its later family-owned investment structure.
